add-digital-signature-to-pdf-page.title: Sign PDF with Visible Signature on First Page
add-digital-signature-to-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to bind a PDF, create a visible digital signature using a PFX certificate, and apply it to page one with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

add-second-digital-signature-to-pdf-page.title: Add Second Digital Signature to PDF Page 3
add-second-digital-signature-to-pdf-page.description: Shows how to place a second digital signature on page three of an existing PDF by defining a rectangle, creating a signature field, and applying a PKCS#1 certificate using Aspose.Pdf.

suppress-reason-location-when-signing-pd.title: Suppress Signature Reason and Location in PDF
suppress-reason-location-when-signing-pd.description: Demonstrates how to create an invisible signature field and sign a PDF while suppressing the Reason, Location, and ContactInfo texts using Aspose.Pdf.

sign-pdf-french-caption.title: Digitally Sign PDF with French Caption
sign-pdf-french-caption.description: Demonstrates applying a PKCS#7 digital signature to a PDF and configuring the signature appearance locale to French using SignatureCustomAppearance.

remove-signature-from-pdf.title: Remove Signature from PDF
remove-signature-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to bind a signed PDF, remove a specific digital signature by name, and save the resulting unsigned document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

verify-pdf-signature-by-name.title: Verify Specific Signature in PDF
verify-pdf-signature-by-name.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf.Facades and check whether a signature named 'ContractSigner' exists and is valid using the VerifySigned method.

validate-manager-signature.title: Validate Manager Signature in PDF
validate-manager-signature.description: Shows how to locate a specific signature field in a PDF and verify its cryptographic integrity using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileSignature.

extract-signing-certificate-from-pdf.title: Extract Signing Certificate from PDF Signature Field
extract-signing-certificate-from-pdf.description: Loads a PDF, locates a signature field named 'LegalSignature', extracts the embedded signing certificate, and saves it as a .cer file.

extract-witness-signature-image.title: Extract Signature Image from PDF Form Field
extract-witness-signature-image.description: Loads a PDF, locates the 'WitnessSignature' signature field, extracts its appearance image, and saves it as a PNG file.

custom-pdf-signature-appearance.title: Create Custom PDF Signature Appearance and Hide Default Caption
custom-pdf-signature-appearance.description: Demonstrates signing a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, applying a custom signature image, and removing the default "Digitally signed by" label using SignatureCustomAppearance.

sign-pdf-with-pfx-certificate.title: Sign PDF with PFX Certificate using Aspose.Pdf
sign-pdf-with-pfx-certificate.description: Demonstrates how to digitally sign a PDF document with a password‑protected PFX certificate, creating a visible signature using Aspose.Pdf.

remove-pdf-signature-missing-handling.title: Remove PDF Signature with Missing Field Error Handling
remove-pdf-signature-missing-handling.description: Loads a signed PDF, checks whether a specified signature field exists, reports available signatures if it does not, and removes the signature when present before saving the unsigned document.

log-pdf-signature-verification-to-json.title: Verify PDF Signatures and Log Results to JSON
log-pdf-signature-verification-to-json.description: Demonstrates how to open a signed PDF, verify each digital signature, and write the verification status to a formatted JSON file.

sign-and-verify-pdf-using-pdffilesignatu.title: Sign and Verify PDF Using PdfFileSignature
sign-and-verify-pdf-using-pdffilesignatu.description: Shows how to digitally sign a PDF with a PFX certificate using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileSignature and then immediately verify the signature's authenticity.

sign-pdf-with-reason-and-location.title: Sign PDF with Reason and Location
sign-pdf-with-reason-and-location.description: Demonstrates how to digitally sign a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades, setting the signature reason to "Approved for release" and the location to "New York" with a visible signature.

add-signature-field-and-sign-pdf.title: Create and Sign a PDF Signature Field on a Specific Page
add-signature-field-and-sign-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to add a signature field to a chosen page of a PDF and then digitally sign it using a PKCS#7 certificate with Aspose.Pdf.

extract-certificate-details-from-pdf-sig.title: Extract Certificate Details from Signed PDF Fields
extract-certificate-details-from-pdf-sig.description: Shows how to load a signed PDF, enumerate its signature fields, extract the embedded X.509 certificate, and output issuer, subject, and validity dates.

generate-pdf-signature-report.title: Generate PDF Signature Verification Report
generate-pdf-signature-report.description: Creates a PDF document that lists all digital signatures in a source PDF, showing each signer, signing date (if available) and whether the signature is valid.

sign-pdf-with-retry-on-file-lock.title: Retry PDF Signing When File Is Locked
sign-pdf-with-retry-on-file-lock.description: Demonstrates how to sign a PDF with a visible signature using Aspose.Pdf and implement a retry mechanism to handle the PDF being locked by another process.

remove-all-signatures-from-pdf.title: Remove All Signatures from a PDF
remove-all-signatures-from-pdf.description: Shows how to bind a signed PDF with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileSignature, remove every digital signature, and save a clean copy.

verify-multiple-pdf-signatures.title: Verify Multiple Signatures in a PDF
verify-multiple-pdf-signatures.description: Demonstrates how to bind a PDF, retrieve all signature names, and verify each signature individually using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileSignature.

extract-signature-images-html-report.title: Extract Images from PDF and Generate HTML Report
extract-signature-images-html-report.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfExtractor to extract all images (e.g., signatures) from a PDF and embed them into a simple HTML file for visual inspection.

sign-pdf-with-semi-transparent-appearanc.title: Create Visible PDF Signature with Semi‑Transparent Background
sign-pdf-with-semi-transparent-appearanc.description: Demonstrates how to add a visible digital signature field to a PDF and customize its appearance with a semi‑transparent background color using Aspose.Pdf.

list-signature-names-in-pdf.title: List Signature Names in a PDF Document
list-signature-names-in-pdf.description: Shows how to retrieve all digital signature names from a PDF file using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

sign-pdf-with-visible-image-signature.title: Add Signature Image to PDF
sign-pdf-with-visible-image-signature.description: Shows how to load a PDF, place a signature image as an ImageStamp on the first page, and save the signed document using Aspose.Pdf.

sign-pdf-visible-signature-last-page.title: Sign PDF with Visible Signature on Last Page
sign-pdf-visible-signature-last-page.description: Demonstrates adding a visible PKCS#7 digital signature to the bottom‑right corner of the last page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

locale-specific-pdf-digital-signature.title: Locale‑Specific PDF Signature Appearance
locale-specific-pdf-digital-signature.description: Demonstrates how to apply digital signatures with visual appearance that adapts to German, Spanish, and Japanese locales using Aspose.Pdf. It sets culture‑aware labels, fonts, and signature metadata per page.

remove-and-replace-pdf-signature.title: Remove Existing Signature and Re‑sign PDF with Updated Certificate
remove-and-replace-pdf-signature.description: Shows how to delete the first digital signature from a PDF and then apply a new PKCS#7 signature using a different certificate.

verify-absence-of-pdf-signature.title: Check PDF for Absence of Digital Signatures
verify-absence-of-pdf-signature.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades to determine that a PDF without digital signatures returns false when verified.

remove-all-signatures-from-pdfs.title: Remove All Signatures from PDFs Recursively
remove-all-signatures-from-pdfs.description: Shows how to walk through a directory tree, find PDF files and strip every digital signature from each document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

extract-certificate-serial-number-from-p.title: Extract Signing Certificate Serial Number from PDF Signatures
extract-certificate-serial-number-from-p.description: Demonstrates how to open a signed PDF, enumerate its digital signatures, extract each signing certificate, and log the certificate's serial number for audit purposes.

list-signature-reasons-and-locations.title: List PDF Signature Reason and Location
list-signature-reasons-and-locations.description: Demonstrates how to open a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, retrieve all active digital signatures, and output each signature's Reason and Location metadata for auditing purposes.

hide-pdf-signature-appearance.title: Sign PDF with Hidden Signature Appearance
hide-pdf-signature-appearance.description: Demonstrates applying a cryptographic digital signature to a PDF while keeping the visual signature field invisible, using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileSignature and PKCS7 classes.

extract-signing-certificate-subject-dn.title: Extract Signing Certificate Subject from PDF
extract-signing-certificate-subject-dn.description: Demonstrates how to read digital signatures in a PDF, extract the signing X.509 certificate, and retrieve its subject distinguished name for storage or further processing.

configure-custom-signature-appearance.title: Sign PDF with Custom Appearance (Foreground Image & Background Color)
configure-custom-signature-appearance.description: Demonstrates how to configure SignatureCustomAppearance to set a background colour and draw a foreground image, then apply a visible PKCS7 signature to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.
